from tools import search_hotels, filter_hotels, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Retrieve the latest hotel search results from cache
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Apply filters for gym and free wifi amenities
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find hotels near the Fountains of Bellagio attraction
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=get_results_from_cache(key="attractions"),
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest hotels results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_hotels)

# Output the query summary
print("No planning needed")
